meta.name: google-agents-cli-workflow
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "develop an agent", "build an agent using ADK", "run the agent locally", "debug agent code", "test an agent", "deploy an agent", "publish an agent", "monitor an agent", or needs the ADK (Agent Development Kit) development lifecycle and coding guidelines. Entrypoint for building ADK agents. Always active — provides the full workflow (scaffold, build, evaluate, deploy, publish, observe), code preservation rules, model selection guidance, and troubleshooting steps for ADK or any agent development.

copy.tagline: 从搭建到上线,把 AI 智能体开发、调试并发布出来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想从零搭建并发布自己的 AI 智能体却不知从哪下手
copy.tagline_en: Build, debug, and ship your own AI agents from scaffold to deployment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build and ship your own AI agents but don't know where to start

howto.what: Claude 会按 ADK 开发流程带你走：先弄清需求、写规格并等你确认，再研究示例配方、搭脚手架、写代码、跑评测、部署、发布、观测，每个阶段前重读对应子技能。
howto.when: 当你提到“开发 agent”“用 ADK 构建 agent”“调试 agent 代码”等，或需要 ADK 开发流程与编码规范时触发；该技能常驻。

say.text: 帮我用 ADK 做一个 agent，先问清需求再动手
say.note: 会先做设计对话，再把规格写进文件等你确认

say.text: 用 agents-cli run 跑一下我刚才改的代码
say.note: 对当前改动做一次终端冒烟测试

say.text: 给这个 agent 加评测用例，跑 agents-cli eval
say.note: 进入评测阶段，先从小规模用例开始

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through the ADK agent lifecycle: clarify the design and spec, study reference recipes, scaffold, build, evaluate, deploy, publish and observe, reloading the matching sub-skill before each phase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to develop an agent, build with ADK, run or debug agent code, or need the ADK development lifecycle and coding guidelines. Always active.

say_en.text: Help me build an agent with ADK, ask about requirements first
say_en.note: Runs a design dialogue, then writes a spec for approval

say_en.text: Smoke-test my latest changes with agents-cli run
say_en.note: Runs a quick one-off check in the terminal

say_en.text: Add eval cases and run agents-cli eval
say_en.note: Moves into evaluation, starting with a few cases
